components.name: NewsletterSignup
components.doc: A newsletter signup framed by the newsletter itself: a stack of recent issues. Subscribing drops the next issue, addressed to the new reader, onto the front of the stack and ticks the reader count up by one. Comes as an inline page section or a self-contained card.

components.name: NewsletterSignupBlock
components.doc: Preview: both layouts. Subscribing is simulated and nothing is sent; the switch makes the next send fail.

members.name: variant
members.doc: `inline` puts the copy and form beside the issue stack; `card` is a self-contained card with the stack in a tray on top.

members.name: privacyNote
members.doc: Short line under the form about frequency and privacy.

members.name: privacyLink
members.doc: Link after the privacy note. Pass null to hide it.

members.name: readers
members.doc: Reader count and up to three faces. The count ticks up by one when someone subscribes. Pass null to hide it.

members.name: publication
members.doc: The issue stack. On success the upcoming issue, addressed to the new reader, lands on top. Pass null for a form without the stack.

members.name: onSubscribe
members.doc: Called with a valid, trimmed email. Reject to show an error and keep the email; resolve to show the success state.

types.name: NewsletterStory
types.doc: One story teased in an issue. `image` is a small square-cropped thumbnail.

types.name: NewsletterIssue
types.doc: One issue of the newsletter, as it appears on the stack.

members.name: date
members.doc: Send date as it should read, such as "Friday, September 25".

types.name: NewsletterPublication
types.doc: The publication shown beside the form: the next issue lands on the stack of recent ones when someone subscribes.

members.name: upcoming
members.doc: The next issue. It is addressed to the new reader and joins the front of the stack on success.

members.name: recent
members.doc: Recent issues, newest first. The first three make the stack.
